meaning.zh:
“哇哦，太棒了！” 或 “真是令人兴奋！”

这个短语来源于英语国家儿童经常吃的糖果 “橡皮糖”（gumdrops），而 “Goody” 一词则源自 “good”，带有兴奋和庆祝意味。它通常用来表达强烈的喜悦和兴奋，类似于中文中的 “太棒了” 或 “好极了”。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the candy "gumdrops" that children often enjoy in English-speaking countries. The word "Goody" is derived from "good" and conveys excitement and a celebratory tone. It is typically used to express strong pleasure and delight, similar to saying "great" or "fantastic" in Chinese.

lines.en: “Goody, goody gumdrops!” she exclaimed when she saw the surprise party.
lines.zh: 当她看到惊喜派对时，她喊道：“哇哦，太棒了！”

lines.en: The kids shouted, “Goody, goody gumdrops!” when they found out they were going to the amusement park.
lines.zh: 孩子们在得知要去游乐园时大喊：“哇哦，太棒了！”

lines.en: “Goody, goody gumdrops!” John yelled as he opened his birthday present.
lines.zh: 约翰在打开生日礼物时喊道：“哇哦，太棒了！”
